headings.usage: Use for primary headings and strong titles. Avoid Inter.

body.usage: For general UI text and descriptions.

monospace.usage: Crucial for Developer tools: Use for Fingerprints, JSON diffs, expectations, and Webhook URLs.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background #121214 with border #27272A. No glassmorphism.
surfaces.modals: Elevated solid surface #18181B with heavy ambient shadow.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12 for containers. p-6 or p-8 inside cards.
layouts.dashboard_grid: List view or Bento-style grids. Rows must accommodate the 30-run timeline squarely.
layouts.empty_states: MUST BE EDUCATIONAL. Generous empty states that teach the 3-step setup. Never use dummy seed data.

timeline_squares.description: The Hero component of the app.
timeline_squares.styles: Sequence of 30 small squares (w-3 h-3 to w-4 h-4), rounded-sm. Rightmost is newest. Pass=bg-emerald-500, Fail=bg-red-500. Add hover tooltip for run details.

curl_example.styles: Darkest background (#000000), JetBrains Mono font, syntax-highlighted appearance, absolute position copy button top-right.

run_detail_panel.description: Panel for checking verdict and diff message.
run_detail_panel.styles: Right-side sliding panel (Sheet) or centered Dialog. Show Pass/Fail loudly at top. Use monospace for Fingerprint data.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT USE INTER FONT. Use Outfit, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono.
Implement the 'dark' theme strictly. Use deep blacks (#0A0A0A) and dark surfaces (#121214).
Empty states MUST NOT be seeded with fake data. Display the 3-step educational setup.
Make the Timeline Squares the primary visual focus of the Dashboard and Check Detail pages.
Do not use glassmorphism. Developer tools need solid readability. Use solid dark backgrounds and subtle 1px borders.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
Use Lucide-react icons, focusing on tech/dev visual metaphors.

landing_hero_background.description: Abstract glowing nodes. Use behind landing page hero text with low opacity (10-20%).

landing_developer_context.description: Code terminal in dark mode. Use in 'problem' or 'how it works' landing page section.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements include a data-testid attribute.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
